themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain and Italy are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services and benefits. This theme has seen strong convergence, with similar legislative efforts and political rhetoric appearing in multiple countries, reflecting a coordinated transnational strategy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Signed agreements with PP in Andalusia to implement 'national priority' in public aid and housing, requiring long-term residency for access.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni government continues to advocate for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in welfare and public services, aligning with broader right-wing trends.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party has long championed 'national preference' policies, which are central to their platform and resonate with similar movements across Europe.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK have increasingly emphasized policies that prioritize British citizens, particularly in welfare and immigration debates.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's platform includes strong rhetoric on prioritizing German citizens in public services, aligning with the broader 'national priority' theme.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are escalating their attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, proposing or enacting legislation that restricts gender identity recognition, limits access to healthcare, and curtails public expressions of LGBTQ+ identities. This theme has seen strong convergence, with similar legislative efforts and political rhetoric appearing in multiple countries.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox continues to push anti-LGBTQ+ policies in regional governments, including restrictions on gender identity recognition and public expressions of LGBTQ+ identities.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni government has proposed and enacted policies that restrict LGBTQ+ rights, including limitations on gender identity recognition and public expressions of LGBTQ+ identities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party has increasingly targeted LGBTQ+ rights in their political rhetoric, aligning with broader right-wing trends in Europe.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has intensified its rhetoric against LGBTQ+ rights, particularly focusing on transgender issues and gender identity recognition.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has proposed legislation that restricts LGBTQ+ rights, including limitations on public expressions of LGBTQ+ identities and access to healthcare.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei has reached out to Peru's President-elect Keiko Fujimori and other right-wing leaders in Latin America to strengthen bilateral ties and promote anti-socialism policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration has shown support for Milei's regional alliances, reflecting a broader transatlantic strategy to counter socialism and promote free-market policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇪 Peru (external)
countries.note: Keiko Fujimori's victory in Peru's presidential election has been celebrated by Milei as an opportunity to strengthen regional ties and promote anti-socialism policies.
